ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicare and Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the recent cases of Medicare and Child Care fraud, and follow the money to see where it leads
questions: What are the most common types of Medicare and Child Care fraud?
How can these types of fraud be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption, and to shed light on the need for increased vigilance and oversight in these areas.
